title: Two agents, one branch, no silent overwrite

actors.task: Add retry policy to payment gateway

timeline.meaning: Both workers start from the same immutable state.
Agent A wins the compare-and-swap and advances the branch.
Agent B is not allowed to silently replace Agent A's newer branch head.
Agent B's immutable proposed commit still exists for inspection or reconciliation.
A human can inspect both outcomes before deciding what belongs in canonical history.
Conflict resolution becomes an explicit history event instead of an invisible last-writer-wins accident.

buyer_takeaway: Lineage turns a race between autonomous workers into an inspectable reconciliation event instead of a silent overwrite.
boundaries: This is synthetic proof data, not a customer incident.
The demo does not grant deployment or production mutation authority.
A stale proposed commit remaining in storage is not the same as it being accepted into canonical branch history.
